user.title: Connect to the Meraki Dashboard
user.description: Create an API key in the Meraki Dashboard under **Organization > API & Webhooks**. A read-only key is enough for monitoring; turning switch ports on and off needs a key with full access.

organization.title: Select organization
organization.description: The API key has access to several organizations. Choose the one to add; you can add the others later.

networks.title: Select networks
networks.description: Choose which networks of {organization} to include. Leave the selection empty to include all networks, including ones added later.

data_description.networks: Only devices in these networks are added to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Cisco Meraki
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {organization} is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Meraki Dashboard API.
error.no_organizations: The API key does not have access to any organization.
error.organization_not_accessible: This API key does not have access to the configured organization.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Meraki Dashboard API.
